params.name: id
params.desc: 对象 node.name (也称 sid), e.g. 'CEILING_A_6F_1'

code: const obj = ssp.objectsTool.getById('CEILING_A_6F_1'); if (obj) { await ssp.cameraController.flyToObject(obj); ssp.objectsTool.setHighlight(obj, '#ff5722'); console.log('focused on', obj.name); } else console.log('not found');
guard: 对象可能不存在 (id 输错), 必须判空
flyToObject 用 camera-controls 自动过渡 (默认 1s)
setHighlight 不传 pulse 时是静态高亮; pulse=true 时闪烁
